title: rnw-community/mobile-ci store-screenshots.yml consumer config
description: Config file loaded by store-screenshots.yml's config-path input. Keys are workflow input names; JSON-blob inputs take the real JSON structure. Editor autocomplete only - CI validation is the workflow's own fail-closed jq allowlist, which is the source of truth.

envMap.description: Extra Maestro -e pairs. The reserved names APP_ID, LOCALE and APPEARANCE fail closed.

device.description: iOS: the exact simulator name. Android: a free-form slug label matching ^[A-Za-z0-9 ._-]+$.

orientation.description: Defaults to portrait. Android entries must be portrait.

name.description: Unique; becomes the output path segment raw/<platform>/<device-slug>/<locale>/<appearance>/<name>.png.

flow.description: Path relative to screenshots-dir; absolute paths and '..' segments fail closed.

ios-target.description: Single iOS build target. Required when capture-manifest has iOS entries.

android-target.description: Single Android build target. Required when capture-manifest has Android entries.

capture-manifest.description: One capture job per entry; at most 256 entries per platform.

capture-mode.description: 'flows' is iOS-only legacy discovery under screenshots-dir; 'direct' is scene-manifest-driven and required for Android.

capture-scenes.description: Required in direct mode; fails closed in flows mode.

screenshots-dir.description: Scene-discovery root in flows mode; the directory flow-backed scenes resolve against in direct mode.

seed-command.description: Per-cell seed hook, direct mode only.

settle-seconds.description: Seconds between a deep-link launch and its screenshot.

status-bar-override.description: Force a store-clean status bar (9:41, full bars, 100% battery).

apple-screenshot-slots.description: Maps '<width>x<height>' pixel resolutions to the slot labels your uploader expects. Labels are free-form non-empty strings; only the keys are format-checked.

maestro-env.description: Newline-separated KEY=VALUE pairs passed as extra -e arguments to every maestro test invocation.

maestro-config.description: Path to the consumer's Maestro workspace config.yaml, passed as --config.

build-env.description: Newline-separated KEY=VALUE pairs appended to $GITHUB_ENV at the start of each build job.

install-command.description: JS dependency install command; must match the resolved package manager.

build-command.description: Optional workspace JS build command run at repo root before the native build.

cache-profile.description: Cache-key prefix distinguishing this consumer/app (iOS build job).

android-cache-profile.description: Cache-key prefix distinguishing this consumer/app (Android build job).

android-gradle-args.description: Extra whitespace-split arguments appended after android-gradle-task.

repack-on-hit.description: On a native-app-cache hit, repack a fresh JS bundle into the cached shell.

upload-screenshots.description: Run the gated upload job. Requires a working consumer-owned upload-command.

upload-command.description: Consumer-owned upload command, e.g. 'bundle exec fastlane ios ios_screenshots'. Required when upload-screenshots is true.

screenshots-download-dir.description: Path, relative to the resolved app directory, every capture artifact is merged into before upload-command runs.

publish-env.description: Newline-separated KEY=VALUE pairs of non-secret env appended to $GITHUB_ENV at the start of the upload job.

asc-dedupe-app-id.description: Bundle identifier of the App Store Connect app whose listing is deduped. Defaults to ios-target's appId.
